data.long_meaning: The name Charanraj is derived from two Sanskrit words – Charan (footstep) and Raj (King). This name symbolizes the divine presence of a king who walks among us. In Hindu mythology, Charanraj is believed to be the name of various gods, including Lord Vishnu and Lord Shiva.
